title: Immune collapse and treatment at Brooke General Hospital
place_text: Brooke General Hospital, San Antonio, Texas

tellings.quote: I end up at Brook General Hospital.

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer who says he has met beings that are not human, says that in 1952, as a child in Texas, his immune system collapsed and he ended up at Brooke General Hospital in San Antonio. He mentions a school report card from the time as part of his account of his early life, which he links to the strange experiences he describes.
